title: Tribe child
desc: Born and raised in a tribe of hunter-gatherers.

title: Peaceful tribe child
desc: Grew up in a peaceful tribe of hunter-gatherers and traders. Taught diplomacy and respect from a young age.

title: Savage tribe child
desc: Spent their childhood in a savage tribe of hunters and warriors. Took their first life at the age of 10.

title: Grub catcher
desc: Digging up grubs by the shore was a favorite pasttime for <name> as a child. Before learning how to fish, they would eat grubs raw, and then wonder why they got sick so often.

title: Hearth tender
desc: Tasked with keeping the fire fed from a young age, <name> learned to cook and care for the hearth. They became a master of fire and cooking.

title: Stone knapper
desc: <name> spent years chipping away at stones, turning mere pebbles into refined tools and weapons. They became a master of stone knapping and weapon crafting.

title: Forager
desc: <name> knows where to find the best berries, nuts, and other resources in the wild. Whether it's a dark night or the middle of the winter, they can find food anywhere.

title: Veteran
desc: <name> has spent years in the wild, fighting off predators and other dangers. Many of their comrades did not survive. The sight of an open wound brings back traumatic memories.

title: Hunter
desc: Knocking down prey with a single shot is a common occurance for <name>. They have a keen eye for target acquisition and a steady hand.

title: Trader
desc: Years of trading with other tribes and settlements have taught <name> the value of diplomacy and negotiation. They can reliably negotiate a profitable deal, and have a knack for finding the best bargains.

title: Herbalist
desc: Wild plants have been a source of medicine for <name> for years. While others might accidentally poison themselves, <name> knows which ones are safe, and especially which ones are useful.

title: Medic
desc: Having sworn an oath to never harm another living being, <name> has dedicated their life to helping the sick and wounded. They have a deep understanding of the human body and how to heal it.

title: Diplomat
desc: Years of diplomacy have taught <name> the value of negotiation and compromise. They can reliably negotiate a profitable deal, and have a knack for finding the best bargains.

title: Philosopher
desc: Studying the nature of the universe might prove fruitless to some, but not to <name>. They have dedicated their life to understanding the world we live in. They're a bit of a shut-in.

title: Cook
desc: <name> knows how to bring the flavor out of any ingredient. They are frequently entrusted with cooking for the tribe, with their dishes being a common sight at feasts and celebrations.
